threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You keep trying to pay with a contactless card, but haven't realized most of the corner shops still prefer cash. Classic rookie mistake.
Caught a guy on the N35 last night, serenading the bus with opera. Must’ve been a proper late-night cabaret. Only in Brixton, eh?

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I spotted a group of elderly men playing chess on a sidewalk while a street artist painted a mural behind them—classic Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you find a thriving street art scene right next to a Turkish market. It's an odd yet beautiful clash of culture and creativity.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only locals brace for the bus delays by packing snacks and a portable charger; the newbies just stand there, bewildered by the chaos.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a woman playing a saxophone in the middle of the street near UN Plaza as Muni buses honked around her. Only in SF, right?

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is just about Gaudí, but the real charm is in the local bars where the 'old timers' debate politics over vermut.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a newcomer by their tendency to ask for a café amb llet at 3 PM; locals stick to an espresso or skip coffee altogether by then.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still refer to Ridley Road Market as the 'Dalston Market' instead of its proper name. That’s a sure sign you’re fresh off the boat.
Heard a couple arguing over whether Jerk chicken or Fried chicken was the best midnight snack. Classic Brixton vibes, though you know the jerk wins every time.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I knew I was home when I saw a group of kids using an abandoned lot to host a mini talent show, complete with an audience of cats lounging nearby.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You can find spontaneous techno parties in abandoned buildings here, but good luck getting a currywurst after midnight. It’s a wild mix!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a local when they know to avoid BART during rush hour because of random delays. Tourists are still shocked by the train chaos on Fridays.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Watched a guy in a suit try to squeeze his briefcase in the bike rack on a crowded 38. He was so determined, you'd think it was his last chance.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think they can hop on the metro any time; the locals know it’s a game of chance after 10 PM—good luck finding a bus!

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You'll catch them staring at the metro map like it's a treasure map, trying to decipher 5 different lines at once.
